about: Breaks and breakups (dungeon/life/breakups.py): after strain in a friendship, not a romance, the companion's first message saying they need distance from the friendship for now. Used only when no model writes the first text; picked by seeded dice. Era-neutral, no gendered words.
templates: I need some distance from our friendship for a while. I'm sorry.
I've been hurt by how things have gone between us. I think I need to step back for now.
I value our friendship, which is why I need some space before I say something I regret.
I don't think I can be close to you right now. I need time to think.
Things have been strained between us for a while. I'm going to take a step back from the friendship.
I'm not ending our friendship forever. I just need some distance for now.
I've felt taken for granted lately, and I need some time apart to sort through it.
I care about you, but I'm hurt. I need to pull back for a bit.
I don't want to fight with you. I'd rather take some space than keep arguing.
I think we need a break from each other as friends. I hope you understand.
I keep showing up for you and feeling alone when I need you. I need some distance.
This has been building for a while. I need to step away from our friendship for now.
I'm sorry, but I don't have it in me to pretend everything's fine between us.
I need time to figure out how I feel about our friendship. Please give me that.
I've been feeling more drained than happy after we spend time together. I need to step back.
What happened really hurt me. I'm not ready to just move past it.
I'd like some space for a while. I'm not saying never, I'm saying not right now.
I still care what happens to you. I just can't be as close as we've been.
I think we need some time apart before we can be good friends again.
I didn't want to just disappear on you, so I'm telling you plainly: I need distance.
I've tried to let it go, and I can't yet. I need a step back from our friendship.
Our friendship has meant so much to me. That's why this hurts as much as it does.
I'm stepping back from us for now. I hope that one day we can talk about it calmly.
I need to protect my peace for a while, and that means some distance from you.
I feel like I don't recognize our friendship anymore. I need time to think.
I'm not angry, exactly. I'm sad, and I need some space.
I can't keep pretending I'm okay with how you treated me. I need some time apart.
I've been the one reaching out for months. I'm going to stop for a while and see how I feel.
Please don't take this as hatred. It's hurt, and I need room to heal from it.
I'm taking a break from our friendship. I'm sorry it's come to this.
I don't think either of us has been a very good friend lately. Let's step back.
I need some distance. If you want to talk about why, I'll be honest with you, just not yet.
You matter to me. Right now, though, I need to be on my own with this.
I feel let down, and I need time before I can see you without feeling that.
I think we've grown apart, and forcing it is making it worse. I'd like some space.
I keep replaying what happened. I need to step back until I can stop.
I'm not ready to be close again. I'll let you know if that changes.
It's been a hard stretch between us. I'm going to keep my distance for a while.
I wish I could brush this off. I can't, and I need some space.
I need you to give me some room for now. Please respect that.
I'm going to take some time away from our friendship. I hope you're okay.
I've felt unseen by you for a while. I need to step back and think about what I want.
I don't want to say anything unkind, so I'm going to step away instead.
This friendship has been one of the best things in my life. Right now it's also one of the hardest.
I think we need to cool off. I'm going to give us some distance.
I'm hurt and tired. I need a break from us as friends.
I'm not cutting you out of my life. I just need a quieter corner of it for a while.
I don't feel like I can trust you the way I used to. I need time.
I'm going to be honest: I need some space from you.
I keep feeling like an afterthought. I need to step back and take care of myself.
We've let a lot go unsaid. I need distance before I'm ready to say it well.
Maybe we're just in different places now. I need some space to figure that out.
I've been sad about us for weeks. I think a little distance is the right thing.
I'd like to stop spending time together for now. It isn't easy to ask.
It's not one thing. It's a lot of small things, and I'm worn out. I need a break.
I think stepping back is kinder than letting this turn bitter.
I miss how easy we used to be. Right now it isn't easy, and I need some space.
I need time to think about whether this friendship still works for me.
I'm not going to pretend I'm fine. I'm taking some time away.
I hope you'll hear this the way I mean it: I care, and I need distance.
I'll always be glad for our good years. Right now I need to step back.
What you said stayed with me, and not in a good way. I need some time apart.
I feel like I've been giving more than I get. I need to rest from that for a while.
I'm going to keep to myself for a while. Please don't take it as cruelty.
I need distance from our friendship until I can think about it without hurting.
I don't want to lose you, but I can't keep going like this. I need some space.
I'm sorry for my part in this. I still need some time away.
I can't be the friend you want right now. I need to step back.
I've decided to take a break from our friendship. I wanted you to hear it from me.
I think some time apart would be good for both of us.
I'm stepping back. Not slamming a door, just closing it gently for now.
I don't know when I'll be ready to be close again. I'll tell you when I am.
I need some quiet from us. I hope you can understand that.
I feel like every conversation leaves me hurt. I need to pause them for a while.
I'm hurt that you didn't show up when it mattered. I need some time.
I'd rather miss you than keep feeling like this around you.
We've drifted into something that doesn't feel good to me. I need distance.
I've been holding this in, and it's made me resentful. I need to step away before it gets worse.
I'm asking for space. That's all I can manage right now.
I can't keep smoothing things over. I need some time away from our friendship.
You've been important to me for a long time. That's why I need to step back instead of blowing up.
I'm not sure how to fix this yet. I need space to work it out.
Let's not see each other for a while. I need to think.
I've been feeling used, and I don't want to feel that about someone I care about. I need distance.
I need to take a step back from our friendship. I hope one day we can find our way back.
It hurts to say, but I think we need some time apart.
I'm going to give this some distance. I hope you take care of yourself.
I don't have the energy to be close right now. I'm sorry.
I feel like we stopped listening to each other. I need some space to breathe.
I want to be fair to you, and I can't be while I'm this upset. I'm stepping back.
I love what we had. I don't love what we've become lately. I need time.
I need you to know this isn't easy. I'm stepping away from our friendship for now.
I'm still hurt, and I don't want to fake being over it. I need distance.
I think we both need some room. Let's give it to each other.
Maybe we can talk again someday. For now, I need to keep my distance.
I've felt disrespected, and I need to step back and think about that.
I wish things were different between us. Right now they aren't, and I need space.
I'm going to stop reaching out for a while. I need to look after myself.
I'm not done caring about you. I'm just done for now.
I'd like some distance. If you need to say anything, I'll listen, just not today.
I keep feeling like I have to earn your time. I need a break from that feeling.
Please give me space. I'll come back to this when I'm ready, if I can.
I don't want to end things on bad terms. I just need to step away for now.
I've been honest with myself, and I need some distance from you.
I feel like I lost my friend somewhere along the way. I need time to grieve that.
I'm taking a step back. It's the gentlest thing I know how to do right now.
